newsitem.title: USA: Little change seen in cyclone off Australia - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Little change seen in cyclone off Australia - WSC.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin is nearly stationary in the Coral Sea off eastern Australia and little change in strength or movement is expected during the next 36 hours, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Tuesday.
Justin, with 60 mph winds, is near 16.5s/151.5e. It will threaten shipping through the period, WSC said.
Further south, Tropical Cyclone Gavin may clip northeastern New Zealand as it becomes extratropical.

Gavin is near 34.0s/176.0e, moving south-southwest at 15 mph with 75 mph winds, and will begin to rapidly weaken during the next 36 hours as it turns south to southeast and crosses northern New Zealand with gusty winds and heavy showers, WSC added.
